name: Aslan (Glorious Empire)
description: Aslan of the Glorious Empire share their biology with Hierate Aslan but were raised under the brutal, expansionist culture of the Empire — a rival Aslan state in the Trojan Reach. Life is hard in the Empire; prospects are limited and hazards are constant. All characters are from the Tokouea'we clan.

traits.name: Dewclaw
traits.description: All Aslan have a dewclaw which can be extended to make for a vicious close combat weapon. The dewclaw uses the Melee (Natural) skill and does 1D+2 damage.

traits.name: Heightened Senses
traits.description: Aslan have better night vision, hearing and sense of smell than humans. All Aslan receive DM+1 to any Recon and Survival checks they have to make.

traits.name: Honour Bound
traits.description: Aslan raised in the Empire operate under a strict code of honour. They cannot back down from a direct challenge without suffering a loss of face (SOC−1 for the remainder of the encounter).

traits.name: Land Sense
traits.description: The Aslan drive to acquire and hold territory is biological, not merely cultural. An Aslan who owns property gains DM+1 on all Morale-equivalent checks while on their own ground.

traits.name: Intolerant
traits.description: Aslan of the Glorious Empire are exceedingly intolerant. Whenever the Tolerance skill is rolled during character creation, the result must be rerolled. Only if Tolerance is rolled a second time may the Traveller take a level in it. If any event awards Tolerance, the Traveller may alternatively take Diplomat instead. Possession of Tolerance is seen as a weakness in Empire society.

source: Aliens of Charted Space Vol. 1; The Glorious Empire, Mongoose Publishing
